text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Academic transcript of high school 4.Custody release form 5.Certificate of completion of Secondary Education/O- level Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not, it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized. 6.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.
